integrity: Analytic Dirichlet proof and reproducible finite checks; finite testing is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive beta as n tends to infinity; facet-integral definition for nonsmooth cube is independent of smooth-boundary convergence hypotheses; unindexed prior small-energy Orlicz asymptotics remain possible.
title: A fixed-energy volume anomaly for cubical hyperbolic-cosine Orlicz bodies
